acercaDe.academicoTexto: ServiLocal is Federico Javier Martino's master's thesis at the Universitat Oberta de Catalunya. It is a working platform in demonstration phase: the data you see is sample data and payments run in Stripe's test environment, with no real charges.
acercaDe.dudas: Questions? Read the <terminos>terms of use</terminos> and the <privacidad>privacy policy</privacidad>.
acercaDe.intro: ServiLocal connects people who need work done at home with professionals in their area: plumbing, electrical work, refurbishment, cleaning or private tuition, among other categories.
acercaDe.metaDescripcion: What ServiLocal is, how it connects customers with home service professionals, and the technology behind it.
acercaDe.paso1Texto: Tell us what you need and where. We filter by category, city, distance, rating and maximum price.
acercaDe.paso2Texto: Browse profiles, prices and verified reviews, and see where each professional is on the map.
acercaDe.paso3Texto: The booking is confirmed with the professional and the payment is processed securely through Stripe.
acercaDe.paso4Texto: Only someone who has completed a service can review it, so the reviews reflect real work.
acercaDe.profesionalesTexto: Publishing a service is free. You set your description, the price range, the charging unit and the coverage radius from your reference address. From then on you receive booking requests that you can accept or decline, and you handle the conversation with the customer from the dashboard itself.
acercaDe.tecnologiaTexto: The platform is built with Next.js and React on the client, a REST API in NestJS, and PostgreSQL with the PostGIS extension for proximity searches. Payments are processed with Stripe and the API documentation is published with OpenAPI.

legal.avisoIdioma: This legal text is published in Spanish only, and the Spanish version is the one that prevails.
